raw_response:
I farm only 2 mu, so I do not play fancy games. I do mostly what has worked on our land before, and I watch what men around me do. If I cut fertilizer too much and lose yield, that hurts more than spending a little extra. Our land has well water, so I will use that when the crop really needs it. For wheat, I will put a heavier hand on fertilizer because wheat here likes a solid base and a couple of waters. For maize after wheat, I will keep the straw handled clean, plant a hybrid seed, and feed it enough so it does not turn pale in summer. I am old now, so I also think about labor. I will use rotary tillage where it saves my back, and for maize I can do less soil turning if the ground condition allows. On 2 mu, I will stay close to the usual local way, not chase big changes.
